research_question: Can compressed ambient context preserve recall while neutralizing adversarial triggers in RAG?
problem_statement: Filtering adversarial RAG chunks destroys valid surrounding information (recall ceiling)
hypothesis: Passing filtered chunks through a heavy autoencoder destroys triggers but retains semantic utility
main_risk: Autoencoder might not destroy advanced triggers

research_question: Can dependency graph summarization scale iterative static-analysis feedback to repository-level generation?
problem_statement: File-level LLM static analysis feedback fails on large repositories due to context exhaustion
hypothesis: Summarizing cross-module SA warnings via dependency graphs reduces context use by 70% while maintaining fix rate
main_risk: Graph summarization might lose critical bug context

research_question: Can base-model activation clustering unsupervisedly infer task boundaries for task-free C-LoRA routing?
problem_statement: C-LoRA routing requires explicit task IDs and fails in task-free continuous streams
hypothesis: Clustering intermediate activations of the frozen base model accurately infers boundaries for routing
main_risk: Activations might drift regardless of task

research_question: Can entropy-driven CPU re-fetching mitigate irreversible information loss in KV cache eviction?
problem_statement: Attention-based KV eviction permanently deletes tokens needed for multi-step reasoning
hypothesis: Re-fetching evicted KV blocks from CPU when generation entropy spikes restores reasoning accuracy
potential_contribution: Compute vs Memory adaptive systems tradeoff
main_risk: PCIe transfer latency might outweigh generation benefits

research_question: Do latent chain-of-thought models render external compiler feedback redundant?
problem_statement: Unclear if new reasoning models benefit from static analysis loops as much as standard LLMs
hypothesis: Reasoning models (o1) self-correct better internally making external compiler feedback marginally useful
potential_contribution: Empirical analysis of reasoning vs external tools
main_risk: Reasoning models still make basic syntax errors

research_question: Can dynamic rank allocation mitigate client-drift in Federated PEFT under extreme data heterogeneity?
problem_statement: Federated PEFT suffers from client drift when data is non-IID
verified_limitation: Data heterogeneity disrupts fixed-rank PEFT updates
hypothesis: Allocating higher LoRA ranks to clients with higher data entropy reduces global drift

research_question: How to computationally isolate retrieval success from generator reasoning failure (Recall Conversion Rate)?
problem_statement: Joint RAG metrics fail to penalize a perfect retriever paired with a hallucinating generator
verified_limitation: Cannot easily isolate the 'Recall Conversion Rate'
hypothesis: A counterfactual evaluation metric isolating reasoning drops provides stronger diagnostic signals

research_question: Does dual-score fusion mitigate visual false-positives in VLM RAG?
problem_statement: Text-based RAG filters fail on multi-modal documents where images contain deceptive visual context
hypothesis: Visual-semantic dual-scoring filters out adversarial image retrieval
main_risk: VLMs are highly sensitive to prompt structure
